Name: OhoDavi Anime Unofficial 1.6 Portraits
Author: bezajel
Description:
[size=5][b]What is this mod for?
[/b][/size]
I love OhoDavi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Stardewvalley Anime Mods[/url], but it hasn't been fully updated to 1.6 yet. OhoDavi is working on the update, but in the meantime I've created my own updated portrait sheets based on OhoDavi's base assets.


[u][size=3]Main Files:[/size]
[/u]
[list]
[*]Asset folder with winter portraits and updated portrait sheets, to replace assets in OhoDavi's mod.[/*]
[*]CP Mod to add Sam and Shane's Joja portraits - [b]IMPORTANT: you need to install this mod in your mod folder in addition to OhoDavi's original[/b][/*]
[/list]
[u][size=3]Optional Files:[/size]
[/u]
[list]
[*]Alt versions of Harvey, adding his moustache.[/*]
[*]Alt beach portraits for Seb, Shane, and Harvey, for compatibility with alt sprites.﻿[/*]
[*]my unofficial version of portraits that OhoDavi has now officially released, and I have removed from the main files.[/*]
[/list]

[u]  ﻿  ﻿Alt Beach Portrait Options:
[/u]
﻿  ﻿Topless Sebastian and Shane - for use with mods that uses a topless beach sprite. New!: These portraits are now included in the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31520]Shirtless Sebby and Shane[/url]﻿.
﻿﻿
﻿  ﻿Sunscreen Harvey - this is most similar to the vanilla portraits and sprite, featuring Harv liberally smeared with sunscreen. He's sun smart!

﻿  ﻿Chest Hair Harvey - for use with mods that add chest hair to Harvey's sprite like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7325]Better Beach Outfits[/url]﻿
﻿
﻿  ﻿Hairy Harvey - chest hair version with added moustache if you prefer him that way!

﻿  ﻿Hatless Harvey - Harv forgets about skin cancer and goes no hat-no sunscreen! Like in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25058]New Harvey Beach Portraits and Sprites[/url]


[size=5][b]What other mods are required?
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]OhoDavi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Stardewvalley Anime Mods[/url][/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]How to install?
[/b][/size]
[u][size=3]﻿CP JojaMart Mod:[/size]
[/u]
[list=1]
[*]﻿Download and extract (unzip) the mod.
[/*]
[*]Move the extracted mod into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]That's all![/*]
[/list]
[u][size=3]Assets for OhoDavi's mod:[/size]
[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract OhoDavi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Stardewvalley Anime Mods[/url]﻿ (CP version) and move to Mods folder[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod's main file "1.6 Assets for OhoDavi Anime Mod'"[/*]
[*]Copy the "assets" folder from this file, and paste into the "﻿[CP] Portrait Anime Mods OhoDavi" folder (OhoDavi's mod)
[/*]
[*]Select 'Replace All' (Windows) or 'Merge' (Mac)[/*]
[/list]
[u][size=3]Harvey with a Moustache:[/size]
[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the optional file[/*]
[*]Move the portraits (PNG files) from this file into the 'assets' folder in OhoDavi's mod, and select 'Replace'
[/*]
[/list]
[u][size=3]Alt Beach Portraits:[/size]
[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the optional file
[/*]
[*]Choose which alt portraits you want to use[/*]
[*]Seb and Shane portraits can be moved directly into the ﻿'assets' folder in OhoDavi's mod; select 'Replace'[/*]
[*]Harvey portraits need to be renamed to 'Harvey_Beach'; so choose the portrait you want and remove the last part of the file name (e.g. 'Harvey_Beach_Hatless.png' should be renamed 'Harvey_Beach.png'. Then you can move the portrait into ﻿the ﻿'assets' folder in OhoDavi's mod and select 'Replace'.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
[color=#f1f1f1]The CP mod was designed and tested for compatibility with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]OhoDavi's Anime Portraits[/url] (CP version) 1.6.6. It should also be compatible with other mods that do not alter Sam and Shane's JojaMart portraits.

The asset downloads are designed to match Stardew Valley 1.6 portrait sheet formats, and OhoDavi's file and folder names, with outfits drawn to match vanilla sprites (regular, winter, and beach sprites). These are not full seasonal versions. If you want OhoDavi portraits for Seasonal Cute use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22876]this mod[/url] instead.[/color]

I'm now working on SVE portraits which will be updated [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34549]here[/url].

If using these portraits to replace files in mods other than OhoDavi's, you may need to change file names to match the other mod.


[size=5][b]Acknowledgements
[/b][/size]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ohodavi?gameId=1303]OhoDavi[/url] - for the open permission on their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]anime portraits mod[/url]. All base portraits belong to them.

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/fifadog?gameId=1303]fifadog[/url] - for permission to use their Emily Ice Festival portrait (vanilla winter outfit), and expanded portrait sheet for Kent, from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22876]Anime Seasonal Outfits[/url].
